environment: Happy DOM, compiled standalone HTML, canvas pixel buffer and controlled animation queue
checks: Compiled-HTML role fixtures cover single pushes, rear pulls and Wizard exchanges, stable monsters and their explicit transport, songs with three partners, moving and anchored supports, presses, hydraulics and combat.
Global reflection uses nearest-source priority, exchanges equally distant actors and draws shape-specific previews.
Wizard exchanges preserve the farther crate and distinguish spell discoveries from walking; returning rays preserve the room, repeat their feedback and Undo restores the original selection.
Gray-backed buttons and black/gray press centers have the exact expected pixels.
Mirror warnings flash only involved backs, preserve diagonals and lock ordinary controls.
A two-weight goal press preserves yellow destination corners and black/gray centres through opening, Undo and replay.
Keys 1/2/3/4, repeated Tab, all four role buttons and image clicks select correctly without advancing the world; Shift+Tab and off-canvas clicks are respected.

Direction buttons work; Undo, Reset, Restart and level selection interrupt animations without stale frames. Reset clears discoveries in the current room; Restart returns to level 1 with its thirty-seven-discovery workshop visible.
Reduced-motion mode paints the final result without timer waits.
Defeat appears only after the combat animation and its Undo restores the four living heroes.
Victory waits for all four heroes and the last frame, disables ordinary controls, and can be undone or restarted.
